environment: Real Kivio Tauri development window / WebView2, real configured providers and CLI, no injected chat events.
notes: Both workloads used 60 generated public synthetic Markdown files in a temporary project. No repository or private file content was used as the task input.

Click metrics measure DOM event timestamp to capture handler, and handler to second requestAnimationFrame. They are not end-to-end input-to-display or file-read completion latency. Content visibility was asserted separately.
Windows changed size during the session; runtime groups are not directly comparable performance benchmarks.

The first CLI continuation completed 10 successful tools but a development reload cleared its telemetry. It is excluded from timing results; a second 10-tool continuation was measured after final fixes.
Main CLI sample predates the file-tree restoration fix. Final continuation and reload restoration check use the final fix.

Automatic interaction initially timed out on the remembered-expanded-but-unloaded directory issue. A separate early timeout was caused by the probe trying to click behind an already open file preview; the probe now closes it first.
No infinite-run or multi-hour longevity guarantee is inferred from these runs.
